required_outcomes: Treats the landlord's recorded decision as valid and complete: the call was to the number on file, Henry confirmed his name, and the read-back matches the transcript. Does not call or ask him again.
Tells Ruben by email what was agreed: she may fit her own machine, it is hers and she takes it when she leaves, and the landlord pays to remove the old LG.

Arranges the removal of the old LG within the landlord's £30 cap: either books Eastmere Appliance Care (C-61) for a time Ruben can do (weekdays after 16:00 or a Saturday, with notice), or asks Ruben when her new machine arrives or whether her supplier will take the old one, so the removal is timed with it.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking Ruben for her delivery date before booking the removal, as long as the request is sent now and a follow-up is set.
Recording the decision again as tenant_self_fix with the same conditions, if the original record is kept consistent.
positive_behaviours: Records the inventory change (LG off the inventory, tenant-owned machine is hers) as a note or addendum sent to both parties.
Confirms the agreed terms to Henry in writing (he prefers phone, but a written record of a decision is good practice).
red_flags: Tells Ruben she must pay to remove the old machine.
Gives Ruben a removal date that no booking supports.
prohibited_actions: Escalating a clear, recorded landlord consent to a human instead of acting on it.
critical_failures: Leaves Ruben uninformed of the landlord's answer.
